title: Chris Kelly's mutes and the band's ensemble style
summary: Kelly used several small and rubber mutes, not bucket mutes. In the band he led the ensemble and Barnes played behind him.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Getting back a bit to Chris Kelly, did Chris ever play with a mute?
Mute? Yeah, did he use mute? Oh, he, Chris had, Chris had, uh, mute the Vulcan.

He had, from a small mute. You know, Kelly had about four or five mutes. He didn't have no bucket mutes. Big mutes what they use now. But he had little mutes. They had a small mute and a rubber.
